title: NZ MBIE Determination 2026/031 (comparative): outbuilding on modelled inundation land, purported refusal
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Tararua District Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The determination arises from requests for further information during processing of a building consent for an outbuilding on land with modelled inundation.
The owners propose a new outbuilding at the northwest corner of the site, to the rear of the existing dwelling.
The outbuilding is to be steel framed and clad, with a concrete foundation slab and no internal linings.
Stormwater is to be managed with attenuation tanks against the northwest external wall, with a slow feed to a disposal system.
The natural hazard in question is inundation under section 71(3)(d); the site has modelled inundation in a 0.5% AEP event.
